description: Validates a task file (YAML, JSON or Markdown) and returns its problems and the normalized task. Read-only. Runs `devflow task validate <path> --json`.

path.description: Task file, relative to the workspace or absolute.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace (the repository root). Default: the directory the MCP server was started in.

name: devflow_task_validate
title: Validate a DevFlow task file
